notes: ELFCAR-derived values are targets only and must not be passed as GNN inputs.
Local ELF maxima are unconstrained by atom distance and may select an atomic basin.
Family-level splitting groups variants sharing the same parent phase identifier.
void_dimension is a geometric accessible-space winding rank, not an electronic or ELF dimensionality label.
void_dimension_valid is 0 when the candidate center maps to an inactive grid voxel; the paired label is -1.
